description: A territory's surgeons ranked by dated reasons they may be worth a call now: a recall or rising MAUDE reports at a company engaged with them for these products (possible supply or service disruption, not a finding of fault), a new FDA clearance for their main company (read as new entrant, new system or line extension), engagement moving to a different main company, a move or practice change, a new surgeon not in the Medicare files yet, a growing practice with no device ties. Each with its evidence, a warm introduction from the rep's customers if one exists, the lists it is already on, and a next step. Give a saved territory by name (its family is used unless one is given) or a family and a place; since (YYYY-MM-DD, default a year ago) keeps the reasons recent, e.g. the date of the last brief. Recall, clearance and switching reasons need the coverage add-on.

cities.description: Cities within the state, to narrow it.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

since.description: Only reasons dated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: a year ago.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit when giving a metro or counties.

territory.description: A saved territory's name or id from my_territories, instead of a place.

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).

name: opportunities
title: Why now: who may be worth a call this week
